scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres api
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres
scripts.dev:current: docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres api && concurrently -k -n admin,captive,monitor -c blue,green,magenta 'dotenv -e .env.current -e .env -- yarn workspace @auraconnect/admin dev -p 3301' 'dotenv -e .env.current -e .env -- yarn workspace @auraconnect/captive-portal dev -p 3302' 'dotenv -e .env.current -e .env -- yarn workspace @auraconnect/monitor dev -p 3303'
scripts.dev:legacy: docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres api && concurrently -k -n legacy -c yellow 'dotenv -e .env.legacy -e .env -- yarn workspace @auraconnect/captive-portal-and-admin-legacy dev -p 3401'
scripts.dev:both: docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres api && concurrently -k -n admin,captive,monitor,legacy -c blue,green,magenta,yellow 'dotenv -e .env.current -e .env -- yarn workspace @auraconnect/admin dev -p 3301' 'dotenv -e .env.current -e .env -- yarn workspace @auraconnect/captive-portal dev -p 3302' 'dotenv -e .env.current -e .env -- yarn workspace @auraconnect/monitor dev -p 3303' 'dotenv -e .env.legacy -e .env -- yarn workspace @auraconnect/captive-portal-and-admin-legacy dev -p 3401'
